shortDescription: The sleek design of this microwave with glass touch controls and a hidden pocket handle allows it to blend seamlessly into any kitchen
metaDescription: The sleek design of this microwave with glass touch controls and a hidden pocket handle allows it to blend seamlessly into any kitchen

features.text: The sleek design allows this microwave to blend seamlessly into the kitchen and is enabled by glass touch controls and a streamlined pocket handle that is hidden from view when not in use
Cook foods to perfection at the touch of a button with sensor cook which monitors your food, automatically adjusting time and power
Remove smoke and odors with a strong ventilation system with four speeds to meet all your cooking needs
Bake and brown your favorite foods with convection cooking, the convenience of a microwave and the performance of an oven
Have the flexibility to cook for a crowd with our generous capacity of 1.9 cu ft
Get evenly-cooked, delicious meals with a stainless interior with diamond design rear wall

Cooking meals is effortless with our multi-stage cooking option which allows you to program power levels and cooking times in advance, so you can defrost, cook and keep a meal warm with one interaction
Get the best of both worlds with combi cooking which combines the speed of a microwave with browning and crisping power of convection
Keep your food clearly visible while it cooks, either in the microwave or on your cooktop with premium LED lighting inside and out
